item.description:
## Continue a thread in an existing worktree
Pick up a thread in a worktree you already have instead of creating a new one, and cleaning up a finished worktree no longer freezes the window.
## Clearer review panel
Finding cards use icon buttons and show who reported each finding, the review panel uses switches, and you can choose how review action icons are labelled. Kulula also finds your pull requests after a thread turn and stops polling checkouts and pull requests while it is idle.
## Easier settings
Settings sections, routing controls and review defaults are tidied, you can pick a third level of model effort, and Add Repository opens its folder pickers as sheets.

## Connect Codex to Xcode
Register Xcode’s development tools from Settings and handle Xcode requests directly in your conversation.
## More capable reviews
Use live web search with Codex by default, and get clearer controls for reviewing pull requests and fixing issues automatically.

## Compare files with recent commits
Choose a recent branch commit to compare against your working files, review its changed file list, and open individual historical diffs. File rows also show whether each change is in the active checkout.
